        box = box.union(
            cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(sx, 0).circle(p.insert_boss_r).extrude(H))
    for sx in (p.disk_hole_radius, -p.disk_hole_radius):
        box = box.cut(
            cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=H - p.insert_len)
              .moveTo(sx, 0).circle(p.insert_hole_r).extrude(p.insert_len))

    # perfboard bosses + M2 pilot holes (perf long side along x)
    hx = p.perf_l / 2 - p.perf_center_inset
    hy = p.perf_w / 2 - p.perf_center_inset
    for sx in (hx, -hx):

            py = p.perf_y_off + sy
            box = box.union(
                cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(px, py).circle(p.perf_boss_r)
                  .extrude(p.perf_boss_h))
            box = box.cut(
                cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(px, py).circle(p.m2_pilot_r)
                  .extrude(p.perf_boss_h))

    # USB access slot through side wall at 3 o'clock

        cq.Workplane("XY")
          .box(p.side_t + p.lip + 2, p.usb_slot_w, p.usb_slot_h, centered=(True, True, False))
          .translate((Ri, 0, p.usb_slot_z)))

    # wire notch at 12 o'clock in front rim (for the 4 input wires)

          .moveTo(0, R).slot2D(p.notch_w, p.notch_w, 0).extrude(p.notch_h))
